name: Ble.sh
description: Installs ble.sh (Bash Line Editor) from the nightly build, providing syntax highlighting, autocompletion, and multiline editing in Bash.

nightly-build-version.description: Nightly build version to install (e.g. 'ble-nightly-20260310+b99cadb'). Defaults to 'ble-nightly', which installs the most recent nightly build.

install-dir.description: Directory to install ble.sh into. Defaults to '/usr/local', which installs blesh for all users.

bashrc.description: Path to the bashrc file to add the ble.sh source line to. Defaults to '/etc/bash.bashrc', which installs blesh for all users.
